content.en: The **Product Method** (Value Added Method) measures the value of goods and services produced by each sector. The **Income Method** calculates GDP by summing all factor incomes generated, such as wages, rents, and profits. The **Expenditure Method** calculates GDP by adding total spending on final goods and services, including consumption, investment, government spending, and net exports.
